nodes.name: invoice-status.ts
nodes.summary: Pure utility module providing invoice status derivation, balance calculation, and number formatting helpers used by the invoicing subsystem.

nodes.name: deriveInvoiceStatus
nodes.summary: Derives the current invoice status enum value (ISSUED, PARTIALLY_PAID, PAID, OVERDUE, etc.) from invoice payment amounts and timestamps.

nodes.name: invoiceBalance
nodes.summary: Calculates the remaining invoice balance as total minus paid minus credited, floored at zero.

nodes.name: formatInvoiceNumber
nodes.summary: Formats a human-readable invoice number from an order ID by extracting and uppercasing the last 8 characters.

nodes.name: formatCreditMemoNumber
nodes.summary: Formats a credit memo number from an order ID and sequence number.

nodes.name: toStoredInvoiceStatus
nodes.summary: Converts an in-memory invoice status value to its stored database representation.

nodes.name: landed-cost.test.ts
nodes.summary: Unit tests for landed cost calculation functions covering charge allocation and unit cost computation scenarios.

nodes.name: landed-cost.ts
nodes.summary: Pure computation module for allocating landed costs (freight, duty, other charges) proportionally across purchase order lines and computing total received unit costs.

nodes.name: allocateLandedCostPerUnit
nodes.summary: Allocates the total landed charges for a purchase order proportionally to a specific line item based on quantity weights, returning the per-unit landed cost.

nodes.name: computeReceivedUnitCost
nodes.summary: Computes the final received unit cost by adding the base unit cost and the proportionally allocated landed cost for a purchase order line.

nodes.name: totalLandedCharges
nodes.summary: Sums all landed charge components (freight, duty, other) from a purchase order into a single decimal total.

nodes.name: msa-storage.ts
nodes.summary: Handles MSA (manufacturer service agreement) report file persistence, reading from local filesystem, and optional upload via webhook or S3-compatible storage.

nodes.name: uploadMsaReport
nodes.summary: Persists an MSA report locally and optionally uploads it via a webhook URL or S3-compatible endpoint based on environment configuration.

nodes.name: persistMsaFile
nodes.summary: Writes MSA file content to the local filesystem using a streaming pipeline, creating parent directories as needed.

nodes.name: readMsaFile
nodes.summary: Reads an MSA file from the local filesystem by relative path, returning null if it does not exist.

nodes.name: notification-provider-status.test.ts
nodes.summary: Unit tests verifying the notification provider status detection logic for email and SMS provider configuration.

nodes.name: notification-provider-status.ts
nodes.summary: Inspects environment variables to determine which notification providers (SendGrid email, Twilio SMS, webhook) are configured and returns a structured status object.

nodes.name: getNotificationProviderStatus
nodes.summary: Returns a structured object describing which notification channels (email via SendGrid, SMS via Twilio, webhook) are active based on environment variable presence.

nodes.name: pick-line-status.test.ts
nodes.summary: Unit tests for the pick line status derivation function covering full pick, short pick, and pending scenarios.

nodes.name: pick-line-status.ts
nodes.summary: Pure function that derives the pick line status (PENDING, PICKED, SHORT) from quantity and picked quantity values for warehouse fulfillment.

nodes.name: derivePickLineStatus
nodes.summary: Derives pick line status from ordered quantity, picked quantity, and short-pick flag for use in WMS fulfillment workflows.

nodes.name: postcss.config.js
nodes.summary: PostCSS configuration for the web app enabling Tailwind CSS and Autoprefixer plugins.

nodes.name: schema.prisma (analytics)
nodes.summary: Prisma schema for the analytics database defining KPI snapshot and AI conversation/message models used for daily reporting and Celestial AI chat history.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a dedicated SQLite database via ANALYTICS_DATABASE_URL; three models: DailyKpiSnapshot, CelestialConversation, CelestialMessage.

nodes.name: schema.prisma (auth)
nodes.summary: Prisma schema for the authentication database defining User and Tenant models with role-based access control enums used for multi-tenant authentication.
nodes.languageNotes: Defines Role enum (SUPER_ADMIN through STAFF) and Plan enum (STARTER, GROWTH, ENTERPRISE) for multi-tenant RBAC.

nodes.name: schema.prisma (compliance)
nodes.summary: Prisma schema for the compliance database defining MSA reporting models (tenant config, manufacturer DIDs, transactions, reports) and batch/expiry tracking for regulated goods.
nodes.languageNotes: Covers MSA (manufacturer service agreement) EDI reporting workflow with MSATenant, MSAManufacturerDid, MSATransaction, MSAReport, and Batch models.

nodes.name: schema.prisma (crm)
nodes.summary: Prisma schema for the CRM database defining Customer, CustomerPrice, VolumePriceBreak, Lead, and Activity models supporting sales pipeline and contract pricing.
nodes.languageNotes: Customer model includes tobacco license fields and credit limit tracking; CustomerPrice and VolumePriceBreak enable tiered contract pricing.

nodes.name: schema.prisma (dispatch)
nodes.summary: Prisma schema for the dispatch database defining DeliveryRoute and RouteStop models with GPS tracking fields for last-mile delivery management.
nodes.languageNotes: DeliveryRoute tracks driver GPS coordinates (lastKnownLat/Lng/At); RouteStop has address as JSON to support flexible address formats.

nodes.name: schema.prisma (inventory)
nodes.summary: Prisma schema for the inventory database defining stock ledger, stock levels, SKUs, warehouses, bin locations, reservations, lots, and serial units for full inventory management.
nodes.languageNotes: Most comprehensive domain schema with 8 models; StockLedgerEntry uses event-sourcing pattern; SKU model supports lot, serial, and regulated goods tracking.

nodes.name: schema.prisma (ledger)
nodes.summary: Prisma schema for the ledger database defining double-entry accounting models: chart of accounts, journal entries, journal lines, bank accounts, and bank statement lines.
nodes.languageNotes: Implements double-entry bookkeeping with ChartAccount, JournalEntry, JournalLine; BankStatementLine supports bank reconciliation workflows.

nodes.name: schema.prisma (notification)
nodes.summary: Prisma schema for the notification database defining the NotificationRequest model supporting email, SMS, and push channels with idempotency key deduplication.
nodes.languageNotes: Single model with idempotency key for deduplication; supports EMAIL, SMS, and PUSH channels via NotificationChannel enum.

nodes.name: schema.prisma (order)
nodes.summary: Prisma schema for the order database defining the complete order lifecycle including orders, line items, backorders, sagas, invoices, credit memos, and shipments.
nodes.languageNotes: OrderSaga implements saga pattern for distributed transaction management; rich enum set covers order status, channel, priority, payment method, and shipment status.

nodes.name: schema.prisma (payment)
nodes.summary: Prisma schema for the payment database defining PaymentIntent, LedgerEntry, PaymentIdempotency, and SavedPaymentMethod models for Stripe-integrated payment processing.
nodes.languageNotes: PaymentIdempotency model prevents duplicate payment processing; LedgerEntry mirrors accounting entries for payment events alongside the main ledger schema.

nodes.name: schema.prisma (purchasing)
nodes.summary: Prisma schema for the purchasing database defining Supplier, PurchaseOrder, PurchaseOrderLine, VendorBill, and VendorBillLine models for the procure-to-pay workflow.
nodes.languageNotes: PurchaseOrder includes landed cost fields (freightAmount, dutyAmount, otherLandedAmount); VendorBill tracks three-way match status via BillMatchStatus enum.
